people.name: Neco
people.line: Egyptian Pharaoh during the reigns of Josiah and Jehoiakim.

translations.web: They cried there, ‘Pharaoh king of Egypt is but a noise; he has let the appointed time pass by.’
translations.bsb: There they will cry out: ‘Pharaoh king of Egypt was all noise; he has let the appointed time pass him by.’
translations.kjv: They did cry there, Pharaoh king of Egypt is but a noise; he hath passed the time appointed.
translations.asv: They cried there, Pharaoh king of Egypt is but a noise; he hath let the appointed time pass by.
